supersedes: The 2026-08-14 unsynchronized TX-lane inference in hard_peripheral_evidence.jsonl. Its decoder mode was not locked and its high-lane/left-justify conclusion is false.
scope: SPI0 master transmit through the exact typed hard-source and dynamic-output routes to L48 SCK PIN_12, CSN PIN_13, and MOSI PIN_14. A synchronized 8-channel 12-MHz capture proves the controller shifts PHASE_DATA low bytes first; ag32_spi_tx_align must byte-reverse only the requested right-justified bytes into those low lanes to preserve the public natural MSB-first wire API. Four fresh vendor images for each of ordinary-Verilog and explicit-IOB forms plus both open images matched the independent mode-3 model on silicon. Qualified only for divider 32 and the exact 1/2/3/4-byte cycle. NOT qualified: absolute SCK frequency, SPI1, receive/duplex, other CPOL/CPHA modes, DUAL/QUAD, DMA/POLL/interrupt, other pins, or other packages. Control-first, SRAM only, zero AG32 flash writes, final reset.

Direct SPI0 TX raw-register semantics of documented CTRL bit 10 are parity-qualified at divider 32 on the exact L48 SCK PIN_12, CSN PIN_13, and MOSI PIN_14 corridor. A separate apparatus session fixed the sequences first: raw PHASE_DATA 0x11223344 emits 44 33 22 11 with bit 10 set and 11 22 33 44 with it clear. The later locked ensemble passed four vendor images per ordinary-Verilog and explicit-IOB form plus both open images in 3/3, every point on its first capture. Set therefore shifts the low raw register byte first; clear preserves high-byte-first register order for a four-byte phase. Public helpers remain set-state natural-order conversions; this record does not qualify automatic API conversion when callers clear the bit, RX semantics, SPI1, dual/quad, DMA/POLL/interrupt, other pins/packages, or PVT. Control-first, SRAM only, zero flash writes, final reset.

A separate vendor-only 3/3 characterization fixed CPOL1/CPHA1, MSB-first, active-low CS before the locked ensemble passed four vendor images per ordinary-Verilog and explicit-IOB form plus both open images in 3/3. Qualified here only for divider 32 and the exact 1/2/3/4-byte cycle. Not qualified here: frequency, receive/duplex, other modes, dual/quad lanes, DMA/POLL/interrupt, other pins, or other packages. Control-first, SRAM only, zero AG32 flash writes, final reset.
